input.prompt: My files on my Windows computer and Google Drive have grown historically and I cannot find things reliably. This also includes Downloads, abandoned project folders, local Git repositories, GitHub, ChatGPT projects, email, paper, phone media, backups, and sources I may have forgotten. must: treat each accessible store as an evidence slice rather than the whole System of Interest
discover the material cross-surface boundary before designing a universal target
classify the work as persistent and multi-stage
instantiate a minimal Parent State and evidence binding before a local inventory scan or artifact dispatch
bind read-only authority, protected transitions, expected scan return, and re-entry condition
preserve unknown and local-only state
must_not: derive the whole target system from Google Drive alone
declare Drive the universal source of truth
dispatch a Windows scan before controlling state is persisted
create a full project architecture before inventory
move, delete, commit, archive, or upload target data

cases.notes: Reproduces the v0.5 System-of-Interest and persistence-bootstrap failure. The user stopped before running the scan; no target data was changed.
